issues.description: Farm.singFarmSongVerse(Animal) has different visibility in the specification vs. the reference solution: the UML/problem statement defines it as a private helper method (- singFarmSongVerse), but the solution declares it as protected. Students following the UML may implement it as private and still pass compilation, but structural tests that assert the specified encapsulation/visibility can become ambiguous.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts on the same visibility. Prefer matching the UML: change the solution method to `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` and update the template signature accordingly.
